text:
maria_dev: FYI running into duplicate-creates when using the Python async SDK (0.7.1) with retries enabled. Seems like idempotency header is different between the first attempt and the replay :confused:

maria_dev: Minimal flow — AsyncClient + streaming upload, server returns 500, SDK retries, server receives a different Idempotency-Key on the retry and creates again.

maria_dev: Repro snippet:
```python
async with RedwoodAsyncClient() as c:
    await c.post('/v1/resources', json=data)  # rely on SDK to inject Idempotency-Key
```

kevin_sdk: Thanks — can you paste request/response headers from logs? Also which retry/backoff config are you using?

maria_dev: Using default retry_on_5xx + exponential backoff (sdk default). Logs show: first request header `Idempotency-Key: rk_abc123` then retry shows `Idempotency-Key: rk_def456` (so SDK regenerated it).

ashok_infra: That smells like middleware ordering — if auth or idempotency injection happens after the retry middleware, a regenerated token could happen. What HTTP backend are you using (httpx/urllib3)?

maria_dev: httpx.AsyncClient under the hood (fastapi sample app). Also noticed this happens only when the request body is an async stream (file uploads).

sara_dx: I think we've seen similar: when body is a streaming AsyncGenerator, httpx clones the request differently on resend which can cause our idempotency decorator to run twice and generate a fresh key. Also if token refresh middleware runs between attempts it may mutate headers.

tim_ops: Workaround for now: explicitly pass an idempotency_key to the call (generated by app) or disable automatic idempotency for streaming calls. Not ideal but should stop dupes. :+1:

maria_dev: Confirmed explicit key stops duplication. But we'd like SDK to preserve user expectation — auto-idempotency should be stable across retries.

kevin_sdk: Filed an issue and started a quick debug run. Two angles: 1) ensure idempotency header is attached before retry middleware so it's preserved across replays, 2) when body is a stream, persist a stable key on the Request object so retries reuse it.

dev-bot: CI test run for branch fix/retain-idempotency-headers started — build #4821.

ashok_infra: Also flagging typing/async ergonomics: our retry decorator loses AsyncGenerator typing when applied to streaming endpoints which prevents type-checkers from catching misuse. We should update wrappers to preserve annotations (functools.wraps isn't enough for async generator signatures).

kevin_sdk: Good catch. I'll add tests for: header preservation during retry, streaming body replay, and mypy test for async generator signatures. Planning a PR with small middleware reorder + stable request attr for idempotency.

maria_dev: Awesome — thanks. Patch would unblock our onboarding test suite.

tim_ops: TL;DR workaround: set idempotency_key in app or set `retries={'max_attempts': 1}` for streaming uploads until fix.

kevin_sdk: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 — includes middleware reorder + unit tests + mypy update. Requesting review from @ashok_infra @sara_dx.

maria_dev: Verified locally against PR — duplication gone in my repro. Will run end-to-end later today. :rocket:

sara_dx: Nice. After merge we should add a short note in changelog and an entry in the DX guide about streaming uploads + idempotency to help users avoid the interim workaround.

kevin_sdk: Agreed. I'll add changelog entry. Closing loop after CI passes. :eyes:
